Name: More Short Hair
Author: oddpine
Description:
I have more hairstyles that I'm planning on adding to this, but I also needed to get this out of my brain and into the world. This mod adds hairstyles for the Farmer to the end of the options so it's compatible with other hairstyle mods (unless you somehow run into a conflicting item ID error, but that's rare). There's a bunch of variations of the tied up hairstyles that I didn't put into the preview image because they're essentially all the same.

Requirements: [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/470174-content-patcher]Content Patcher[/url].

Installation:
[list=1]
[*] Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/470174-content-patcher]Content Patcher[/url].
[*] Download this mod and unzip it (extract all) into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*] Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]Permissions:
[list][*] Don't re-release any part of this mod without permission.
[*] Don't reupload this to any other site.
[*] Edits okay for personal use.
[/list]
Special Thanks to Malic's [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/980847-non-replacing-hair-resource]Non-Replacing Hair Resource[/url].
